abort.already_configured: This Glow device is already configured.
abort.invalid_discovery_info: The discovered MQTT message isn't from a Glow device.

error.overlaps_existing_entry: Another entry already reads this device's messages. An entry with device ID + reads every device with its topic prefix, so it can't be added next to an entry for a single device with the same prefix.

user.title: Hildebrand Glow IHD Integration
user.description: Configuring the Hildebrand Glow IHD Integration.

data_description.name: Used for the device's name and the start of new entity IDs, e.g. Home gives sensor.home_electricity_import.
data_description.device_id: Leave as + to detect every Glow device publishing to your MQTT broker. To read one device only, enter its ID from its topics, e.g. AABBCCDDEEFF in glow/AABBCCDDEEFF/STATE.
data_description.topic_prefix: The first part of the device's MQTT topics. Leave as glow unless you changed it on the device.
data_description.electricity_tariff_type: Choose Fixed if your electricity unit rate stays the same all day. Choose Variable if it changes during the day: Electricity: Cost (Today) then adds up each reading's usage at the rate at the time, and the week and month cost sensors aren't made.
data_description.time_zone_electricity: The time zone the electricity meter's daily totals reset in.
data_description.time_zone_gas: The time zone the gas meter's daily totals reset in. Some gas meters reset at midnight UTC, if yours does choose UTC.

reconfigure.title: Hildebrand Glow IHD Integration
reconfigure.description: Change the name, or which Glow device's messages this entry reads. A new name renames the device, but entity IDs that already exist aren't changed.

init.title: Hildebrand Glow IHD Integration
init.description: Change the electricity tariff type and the time zones the meters use. To change the device ID or topic prefix, use Reconfigure.

data_description.electricity_tariff_type: Choose Fixed if your electricity unit rate stays the same all day. Choose Variable if it changes during the day: Electricity: Cost (Today) then adds up each reading's usage at the rate at the time, and the week and month cost sensors aren't made.
data_description.electricity_unit_rate_entity: Variable tariff only, optional. A sensor with your current unit rate in GBP/kWh or p/kWh, e.g. from your supplier's integration, for when the IHD doesn't report rate changes. While it is unavailable the IHD's rate is used.

mqtt_not_available.message: The MQTT integration is not available. Set up MQTT, then try again.

no_messages.title: No messages from a Glow device
no_messages.description:
{title} hasn't received any messages on {topic} in the {minutes} minutes since it was set up, so it has no sensors.

Check that the Glow device is publishing to your MQTT broker, and that the entry's device ID and topic prefix match its topics. You can change them with Reconfigure on the integration's page. This issue goes away when a message arrives.

confirm.title: Electricity cost sensors removed
confirm.description:
{title} was changed to a variable electricity tariff, so these sensors were removed:

{entities}

The IHD only reports the current unit rate, so the week's and month's kWh can't be priced on a variable tariff. Check any automations, scripts, dashboards and the Energy dashboard that used them. Their history is kept, and changing back to a fixed tariff under Configure makes them again.

Submit to dismiss this notice.
